t: This is 2 Willow Road, one of a terrace of three houses in Hampstead, completed in 1939. It was designed by the architect Ernő Goldfinger, who lived here with his wife Ursula and their children until his death in 1987. It is one of the first Modernist buildings the National Trust acquired, in 1995, which caused some controversy at the time. It is now open to the public, so you can see how the architect himself chose to live.
